title: MITRE T1059.001 Suspicious PowerShell Execution Triage Playbook
description: Researcher-constructed workflow for investigating encoded/obfuscated PowerShell commands (Sysmon Event ID 1 & PowerShell Operational Event ID 4104).
approval_requirements: Tier 2 approval required before host network isolation.
closure_requirements: Requires deobfuscated script block analysis, parent-child process tree verification, and network/file IOC check.

steps.step_description: Examine Sysmon Event ID 1 ProcessImage, ParentImage, and CommandLine arguments.

steps.step_name: Retrieve & Decode Script Block Text (Event ID 4104)
steps.step_description: Extract PowerShell Event ID 4104 ScriptBlockText and decode Base64/compressed payloads safely without execution.

steps.step_name: Correlate Outbound Network & File Creation Indicators
steps.step_description: Check destination_ip, destination_domain, destination_port, and dropped file_hash values.
Conditional containment when script block performs credential dumping, C2 download, or lateral movement.

steps.step_name: Validate Administrative Legitimacy or Close Case
steps.step_description: Verify signed IT automation change ticket or finalize true-positive incident escalation.
